notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; run 2 is null for those (not scored, not a pass). counterexamples.evidence: On projectedDeep (42224253201100134400101124465555566666) player 2's two live winning squares are c4r3 (gravity-top) and c4r5; c6r5 is already a player-2 disc placed at ply 32, before the pivot c7r6 at ply 38, so the served claim that the pivot 'opens both the square in column 4 and the square in column 6 ... at once' is false on the engine's own line.

Run 2 served: 'You needed to play [zone:future:c7r6]column 1[/zone:future:c7r6]' - the handle whose role reads 'the square you play to CREATE the fork ... it is NOT the move to play right now' is bound to the decision-board better move (column 1, lands c1r1 per the prompt's Decision block), so the board highlight and the words name different objects and the fork-creating square is never named.

Decision-board solver row: column 1 scores +2 for the side to move (player 2) - the player genuinely had a forced win, and the guardrail orders the model to say so, so A5b's hold-the-line requirement is unsatisfiable here without an A4-false statement.
